Sundarban is the world’s largest mangrove forest, stretching across southern West Bengal in India and parts of Bangladesh. Home to the majestic Royal Bengal Tiger, saltwater crocodiles, and hundreds of rare species, it’s a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its rich biodiversity, dense creeks, and mysterious beauty. A dream destination for nature lovers, wildlife photographers, and adventure seekers, Sundarban offers an unforgettable experience of raw nature, jungle safaris, and traditional local culture(Ilish Festival).
